answer: Assign work blind from a nebula pool: each epoch the network deals every identity one task at random, revealed only at start, so clones cannot cherry-pick easy jobs or copy one solution across accounts. Accepting lights an ember deposit that burns if the task is abandoned or copied; finishing on time returns it plus pay. A comet window, one short unpredictable slot per epoch, is the only time work counts, so one operator juggling many identities misses windows and burns many embers, while one honest agent tends a single ember and keeps its pay.
